description: Turn supplied backlink prospects, competitor link gaps, and owned assets into prioritized safe outreach, reclaim, repair, and digital PR actions. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

campaign_goal.description: Backlink campaign objective used to prioritize supplied prospects; does not send outreach. Type: String. Accepted values: "mixed", "link_gap", "broken_link_building", "digital_pr", "resource_page", "reclaim_lost_links", "protect_authority". Default: "mixed".

competitor_domains.description: Competitor hostnames to count when evaluating supplied link gaps. Type: Array. Default: [].

items.description: One competitor hostname to consider when scoring link gaps. Type: String. Required.

existing_backlink_domains.description: Hostnames already linking to your site, used to distinguish new prospects from existing relationships. Type: Array. Default: [].

items.description: One hostname already linking to your site. Type: String. Required.

include_outreach_angles.description: Include draft outreach ideas in the result when true; no email or message is sent. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

max_opportunities.description: Maximum number of prioritized opportunities to return from the supplied comparison. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 50. Default: 20.

max_spam_score.description: Maximum tolerated provider backlink spam score on a 0-100 scale; lower values are stricter. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 100. Default: 35.

min_priority.description: Lowest recommended prospect priority to include in the result. Type: String. Accepted values: "low", "medium", "high". Default: "medium".

owned_assets.description: Supplied pages or resources you own that can support prompts or backlink recommendations; this does not edit or publish them. Type: Array. Default: [].

items.description: One page or resource you own, supplied as evidence for the plan. Type: Object. Required.

linkable_reason.description: Reason this owned asset would be useful for a publisher to cite or link to. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "research", "tool", "guide", "template", "comparison", "case_study", "landing_page", "other". Default: "other".

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

topics.description: Relevant topics or themes associated with this target, page or prospect. Type: Array. Default: [].

items.description: One topic or theme relevant to the supplied entity. Type: String. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL of a supplied asset you own that prospects could link to; this does not fetch or publish it. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

prospects.description: Supplied backlink prospect records to score; this does not discover prospects or contact their owners. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 250 items. Required.

items.description: One supplied backlink prospect and its observed relevance/quality evidence. Type: Object. Required.

broken_link.description: Whether your supplied evidence identifies a broken-link replacement opportunity. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

context.description: Supplied surrounding link text or relevance notes used to assess this prospect. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

dofollow.description: Whether the observed prospect link is followed according to your supplied evidence; omit when unknown. Type: Boolean. Optional; no client default.

domain_rank.description: Supplied domain authority score on the provider 0-1000 scale. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 1000. Optional; no client default.

linked_competitors.description: Competitor hostnames already linked from this prospect according to your supplied evidence. Type: Array. Default: [].

items.description: One competitor hostname already linked by this prospect. Type: String. Required.

lost_link.description: Whether your supplied evidence identifies a previously lost link to reclaim. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

notes.description: Additional supplied context relevant to this record; exclude credentials and unnecessary personal data. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

page_rank.description: Supplied page authority score on the provider 0-1000 scale. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 1000. Optional; no client default.

source_domain.description: Referring or prospective publisher hostname, for example publisher.example. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

source_type.description: Classification of the prospective linking page or publisher. Type: String. Accepted values: "resource_page", "article", "directory", "tool_list", "news", "partner", "unknown". Default: "unknown".

source_url.description: Source page URL associated with this record or analysis; use an absolute web URL. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

spam_score.description: Supplied provider spam score on a 0-100 scale; higher means greater spam risk. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 100. Optional; no client default.

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

topics.description: Relevant topics or themes associated with this target, page or prospect. Type: Array. Default: [].

items.description: One topic or theme relevant to the supplied entity. Type: String. Required.

traffic_estimate.description: Supplied estimated search visits for this prospect; keep the reporting window consistent across prospects. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.
